description: Pure-code classic machine learning: a scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier with fixed conservative hyperparameters predicts, per instrument, the probability that the next 10-bar return beats the ledger's round-trip cost, from price/volume features on complete daily bars (Gu, Kelly & Xiu 2020). Trained walk-forward with purging and embargo (Lopez de Prado 2018), retrained at most weekly; at most 2 long calls a day above a 0.55 calibrated probability, 10-bar hold, 3xATR20 stop. Zero LLM tokens.
output_character: daily long-only directional calls (0-2) on sector SPDR ETFs, broad index ETFs, gold, long bonds and BTC/ETH; 10-bar hold, ATR disaster stop
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
^VIX daily close via gateway.price_history (optional feature; missing values allowed)
author: MarketMind (pure code, owner decision 2026-09-29)
